description: Defines the ConfigValues class which manages build configuration parameters such as compiler flags, include directories, and external dependencies for a build system.

classes.name: ConfigValues
classes.description: A class that encapsulates various build configuration settings such as compiler flags, include directories, and external dependencies.

methods.name: AppendValues
methods.description: Appends configuration values from another ConfigValues instance.

methods.name: inputs()
methods.description: Returns the list of source files associated with this configuration.

methods.name: libs()
methods.description: Returns the list of library files associated with this configuration.

methods.name: externs()
methods.description: Returns external dependencies as pairs of string identifiers and LibFile objects.

methods.name: has_precompiled_headers()
methods.description: Checks if precompiled headers or sources are set.
